result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a well-maintained sidewalk and clear curb separation from the roadway. However, the presence of a large transit vehicle creates a significant visual obstruction, and there is a lack of visible crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures in the immediate vicinity.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large transit bus significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and vehicles in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, occupying most of the left and center frame

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure clear sightlines at potential crossing points by restricting large vehicle standing or parking near intersections or gates.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: If this is a frequent transit boarding area, a high-visibility marked crosswalk would improve pedestrian safety.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides and a signalized intersection with a marked crosswalk in the distance. However, the environment is characterized by a long blank wall on one side and parallel parking on the other, which can limit visibility and passive surveillance.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: A long brick wall on the left side of the street reduces passive surveillance and street activity.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to manage vehicle speeds on this straight residential stretch.

result.summary: This is a residential street with brick row houses and a continuous sidewalk. Parked cars and street trees provide a buffer between pedestrians and the roadway, though the sidewalk width is somewhat constrained by street furniture like a bike rack.

hazards.name: Narrow effective sidewalk width
hazards.description: The presence of a bike rack and building steps reduces the clear walking width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Dooring risk
hazards.description: Pedestrians walking near the curb are at risk from doors of parked vehicles opening into their path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line where the gold car is parked

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the sidewalk to provide more clear space for pedestrians, especially around street furniture.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting specifically designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street features a two-lane roadway with sidewalks and mature trees on both sides, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks marked crossings and is currently impacted by significant visual obstructions from a large bus and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large bus in the right lane completely blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the right sidewalk and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing attempts.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street create visual barriers for pedestrians attempting to enter the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.
